voices.sourceText: I've no intention of telling you.
voices.displayText: I've no intention of telling you.

voices.sourceText: No matter how often you ask,＆I'll never tell=@
voices.displayText:
No matter how often you ask,
I'll never tell...

voices.sourceText: The mirror=@it's-it's buried=@＆under the cherry tree=@
voices.displayText:
The mirror...it's-it's buried...
under the cherry tree...

voices.sourceText: Keep friends, those you love,＆close to you=@
voices.displayText:
Keep friends, those you love,
close to you...

voices.sourceText: For the last time=@＆Where is the mirror?
voices.displayText:
For the last time...
Where is the mirror?

voices.sourceText: Do you remember Zhao Sun Ming?
voices.displayText: Do you remember Zhao Sun Ming?

voices.sourceText: That's the name of the man＆you killed in Meng Cun.
voices.displayText:
That's the name of the man
you killed in Meng Cun.

voices.sourceText: Get up. I'll allow you to die＆like a warrior.
voices.displayText:
Get up. I'll allow you to die
like a warrior.
